governanceNotes: Deferral reason 1 (phenotype-identity barrier): the single viable catalog target, patellofemoral-pain-syndrome, is defined by the anterior knee pain that is itself a defining feature of chondromalacia patellae; authoring an edge between them would largely restate the diagnostic presentation rather than map a distinct secondary condition, the same barrier ME-41 applied to schizoaffective-style identity overlaps.

Deferral reason 2 (contradictory progression literature): the modern cell-therapy review asserts CMP may progress to patellofemoral osteoarthritis while the classic clinical-concepts paper explicitly found no evidence of progression and called PFOA probably a different entity; automation cannot adjudicate a 37-year evidentiary contradiction, and the catalog contains no patellofemoral-osteoarthritis identity in any case.

Long-term surgical-series context recorded (Fonseca 2013, PMID 23631358): 27-year Maquet III follow-up documents modest persistent patellofemoral disease (40% Kellgren-Lawrence grade 1), consistent with a slowly progressive course in operated populations; recorded as context, not as comorbidity evidence.
